name: ORKS: BOYZ
description:
Boyz are the rank and file of the Orks – each one a massive green brute. They go to battle in large, unruly mobs, led by a Nob to inspire the troops through example and simple intimidation. Tough and determined infantry, their battered armour and crude, varied weapons give them a motley appearance.

The Brutal Heart of Your Waaagh!

This multipart plastic kit builds 1 Nob, 9 Boyz, and 1 Ammo Runt, indispensable infantry warriors for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with choppas, sluggas, and shootas, they are a threat at range and in the swirl of melee. No matter the size of your Ork army, you'll need plenty of Boyz to take and hold objectives and keep the pressure on your enemies.

Kustomise Your Boyz

The Nob can be assembled with either a kustom choppa or power klaw and a kombi-skorcha, or a two-handed big choppa, with your choice of 2 bosspoles and 4 different heads. One of the Boyz can be assembled with an optional big shoota, another with a burna, and yet another with a rokkit launcha. This versatile kit also includes several interchangeable parts, allowing you to customise your Boyz in a variety of ways.

Interchangeable parts:
– 17 heads
– 4 sets of arms holding shootas
– 8 left arms holding a variety of sluggas and choppas
– 6 right arms holding a variety of sluggas and choppas
– 3 pieces of shoulder armour
– 8 holstered back-mounted weapons
– 16 accessories including grenades, trophies, and pouches
– 5 base decorations

Contents:
– 149 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 40mm Round Base
– 9 Citadel 32mm Round Bases
– 1 Citadel 25mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Orks Transfer Sheet

The Orks Transfer Sheet features 385 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Goffs, Bad Moons, Snakebites, Evil Suns, Blood Axes, and Deathskulls, as well as universal Ork glyphs, symbols, and decorations.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
